fusions.name: Reeking Cut
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it then spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Fouling Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 6 damage to everything in it with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Blunted] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Carcass Reek
fusions.desc: The nearest body within 9 tiles rots where it lies for 8 seconds, and leaves every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Clinging Warning
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 8% poison resistance.
